name: Error-Driven 2D Gaussian Training
definition: A densification strategy that samples and optimizes 2D Gaussian kernels in image space using a differentiable rasterizer, then back-projects them to 3D. It uses pre-rendered images as fixed backgrounds.
summary: Error-Driven 2D Gaussian Training is a densification strategy that optimizes 2D Gaussian kernels in image space using rendering loss to precisely initialize new 3D primitives, differing from standard methods by optimizing in 2D with a fixed background.
